free_tier_limits: Free Basic Individual: up to 500 API calls/day and 100,000 Data API records per call.
description: The UN Comtrade API provides official global trade statistics by reporter, partner, commodity classification, period, and trade flow. Tightly limited preview APIs work without an account or key. Registered free users can obtain a subscription key for broader Data API access, while premium subscriptions add bulk and asynchronous APIs, larger per-call limits, and higher daily quotas.
resolution_notes: docs_url: incorrect; the current official API guide is https://uncomtrade.org/docs/un-comtrade-api/. free_tier_limits: incorrect; Basic Individual allows 500 calls/day and 100,000 Data API records per call, not per month: https://uncomtrade.org/docs/subscriptions/. description: incorrect; official docs confirm keyless preview endpoints, keyed free APIs, and premium bulk/async access: https://uncomtrade.org/docs/un-comtrade-api/.
